title: Extending connectcore
text: Subclass RestClient override two private seams. .sign() authenticates request (default -auth); .parse_envelope() turns response data raises error (default “JSON body, error non-2xx”). Endpoint methods delegate private .request() funnel, injects base URL, credentials, seams, retry/throttle config. Constructing async = TRUE makes every endpoint return promises::promise instead value — class mode-transparent, method bodies change.
code: MyClient <- R6::R6Class(   "MyClient",   inherit = connectcore::RestClient,   public = list(     initialize = function(keys = NULL, base_url = "https://api.example.com") {       return(super$initialize(keys = keys, base_url = base_url, body_format = "query"))     },     # A public endpoint method — the funnel is private, so this is how callers     # reach it.     ticker = function(symbol) {       return(private$.request("/v1/ticker", query = list(symbol = symbol)))     }   ),   private = list(     # Authenticate by delegating to the shared HMAC-query helper.     .sign = function(req, keys, ctx) {       return(connectcore::hmac_query_sign(req, keys, ctx$get_timestamp_ms))     }   ) )  client <- MyClient$new() client$is_async #> [1] FALSE

title: Extending connectcore
text: StreamClient event-driven, like ws.(...) Node. minimal recorder needs subclass — register handler run loop: Subclass classify frames events (.dispatch()) replay subscriptions every (re)connect (.resubscribe()); reconnect / keepalive / watchdog machinery inherited. whole contract: supply source specifics, inherit transport.
code: ws <- StreamClient$new("wss://stream.example.com", stale_timeout = 120) ws$on("open", function(e) ws$send('{"subscribe": "all"}')) ws$on("message", function(msg) cat(msg, "\n")) ws$run() # keeps the process alive and pumps the event loop MyStream <- R6::R6Class(   "MyStream",   inherit = connectcore::StreamClient,   private = list(     # Turn one raw frame into typed events instead of the default "message".     .dispatch = function(raw) {       msg <- jsonlite::fromJSON(raw, simplifyVector = FALSE)       return(private$.emit(msg$type %||% "message", msg))     },     # Re-send subscriptions after each (re)connect.     .resubscribe = function() {       return(self$send('{"subscribe": "trades"}'))     }   ) )

text: shared transport base R data-source connectors. owns transport — domain vocabulary, domain dependencies. build connector extending two base classes supplying genuinely source-specific; everything else inherited. mostly place put building stack connectors taught us, next one starts lessons already baked .

title: Reusable Base for REST and WebSocket Data-Source Connectors
text: One codebase sync async — two. Route every result single branch point (then_or_now()), write methods mode-agnostically, choose sync async construction. RestClient mode-transparent. Keep request funnel private; expose typed endpoint methods. Every call flows one private$.request(), signing, error envelope, retry, throttle live one place instead scattered across endpoints. funnel covers awkward cases : body_format = "raw" sends pre-serialized body byte-verbatim (venues sign exact body bytes — NULL-pruning pretty-printing), .request(base_url = ...) overrides host single call (dual-host venues). two things genuinely venue-specific: authenticate, read error. Make exactly two overridable seams — .sign() .parse_envelope() — sane defaults (-auth, error non-2xx). simple public API needs overrides . WebSockets fail silently. onClose always fire, dead socket looks alive. need silence watchdog (force-reconnect N seconds quiet), full-jitter backoff (reconnect storm trips server’s rate limit), proactive reconnect (beat forced cutoff). StreamClient ; subclass classify frames events. Coerce JSON , centrally. Flat data.tables, snake_case names, list columns — shared toolkit, hand-rolled per endpoint. Type every argument return. roxyassert contracts fail loudly boundary, instead letting malformed value surface three calls later.

text: httr2 native global mock hook — options(httr2_mock = ...) — intercepts synchronous req_perform() asynchronous req_perform_promise(). connectcore ships small harness , connector renders docs runs suite canned fixtures network, credentials, funds (async path covered router). Define route table wrap code with_mock_api(): route’s match either string (matched substring request URL — style coinbase, alpaca, binance, kucoin use) function(req) predicate can read URL, method, body. Body-routed APIs (e.g. Hyperliquid, whose whole REST surface sits behind /info /exchange, keyed body field) built body_routes(): fixture invoked per request, counter closure expresses stateful route (paginate: page 1, empty page); fixture may return fully-built httr2_response (204 -content, error), passed unchanged. mock_response() builds response list (JSON-encoded), verbatim JSON string, existing response; load_fixtures(dir) reads directory real captured *.json named route table; local_mock_api() withr::local_* companion use inside test_that() block.

text: Node.js-style event-driven base long-lived WebSocket streams (long-lived push feed). register handlers $(event, handler) — exactly like ws.("message", ...) JavaScript — library calls messages arrive R's event loop (later package, , like Node, built libuv). Concrete connectors subclass override two seams — .dispatch() (raw frame becomes events) .resubscribe() (re-send (re)connect) — getting reconnect / keepalive / watchdog machinery free.

what: Why no async flag (unlike a REST client)
title: StreamClient: Event-Driven WebSocket Base for Connectors — StreamClient
text: REST call single result, can return value (sync) promise (async). socket endless push stream single result, sensible shape callback. Streams therefore always event-driven; one thing R needs Node gives free way keep process alive pump loop — $run().

title: StreamClient: Event-Driven WebSocket Base for Connectors — StreamClient
text: set open — $(event, ...) accepts string, subclass' .dispatch() may emit (e.g. one event per message type). base emits standard core: "open" — socket connected (payload: open event). "message" — default .dispatch() emits every frame, carrying message character string (binary frames decoded rawToChar() first, handler always gets text). "close" / "error" — socket closed / errored (payload: event). "reconnecting" — retry (payload: list(attempt, delay)). "reconnected" — reconnect (first connect) succeeded. "giveup" — max_reconnects exhausted; $run() loop exit. "stale" — silence watchdog fired (frame within stale_timeout).

title: StreamClient: Event-Driven WebSocket Base for Connectors — StreamClient
text: Alongside string-keyed $() callbacks , $on_event(handler) delivers single typed object (see ws_event) every lifecycle transition — open, message, close, error, reconnect (see WS_EVENT_TYPES) — lubridate UTC timestamp per-type fields (close carries code + reason; reconnect carries attempt + delay; open carries reconnect; message carries data; error carries error). WebSocket analogue typed REST conditions (?connectcore_conditions): branch event$event_type read fields data instead re-parsing raw callback payload. additive — $() callbacks unchanged — typed object materialised $on_event() handler registered, parse-free hot path stays free default.

title: StreamClient: Event-Driven WebSocket Base for Connectors — StreamClient
text: Auto-reconnect full-jitter exponential backoff, reconnect storm trip connection rate limit. Silence watchdog — stale_timeout set frame arrives within , socket force-closed reopened (dead connection never fired onClose). Proactive reconnect — proactive_reconnect set, reconnect many seconds opening (e.g. beat server's 24-hour forced cutoff). Re-subscribe every (re)connect via .resubscribe() hook. Keepalive keeps one task later queue host-driven (!later::loop_empty()) loop never exits early frames.

text: Constructs httr2::request, optionally signs , performs (sync async), parses response envelope, applies post-parser. Every REST call connector makes flows . Venue specifics injected: sign (authenticate), parse_envelope (turn response data detect errors), body_format (request body encoded).

title: Build and perform a REST request (the single funnel) — build_request
code: build_request(   base_url,   endpoint,   method = "GET",   query = list(),   body = NULL,   keys = NULL,   sign = NULL,   parse_envelope = parse_json_response,   body_format = c("json", "query", "none", "raw"),   raw_content_type = "application/json",   .perform = httr2::req_perform,   .parser = identity,   is_async = FALSE,   timeout = 30,   user_agent = "dereckscompany/connectcore",   max_tries = 1L,   throttle_rate = NULL,   ctx = list() )

title: Build and perform a REST request (the single funnel) — build_request
text: base_url (scalar<character>) API base URL. endpoint (scalar<character>) path appended base_url. method (scalar<character>) HTTP method. Default "GET". query (list) query parameters; NULL entries dropped. vector-valued entry repeats key (.multi = "explode"), e.g. ids = c("", "B") becomes ids=&ids=B. body (list | scalar<character> | raw | NULL) request body. body_format = "raw" pre-serialized scalar character (raw) sent verbatim; otherwise list whose NULL entries dropped. Default NULL. keys (list | NULL) credentials passed sign; NULL skips signing. sign (function | NULL) function(req, keys, ctx) returning signed request. NULL (default) means signing. parse_envelope (function) function(resp) turning response data, raising error. Default parse_json_response(). body_format (scalar<character c("json", "query", "none", "raw")>) body encoded: pretty-printed JSON body (NULL fields pruned), merged query string (signed APIs), ignored, — "raw" — sent byte-verbatim via httr2::req_body_raw() pruning, pretty-printing, re-encoding (caller owns serialization; required venues sign exact body bytes). Default "json". raw_content_type (scalar<character>) Content-Type "raw" body. Ignored unless body_format = "raw". Default "application/json". .perform (function) httr2 perform function (httr2::req_perform httr2::req_perform_promise). Default httr2::req_perform. .parser (function) post-processor applied parsed data. Default base::identity. is_async (scalar<logical>) whether .perform returns promise. Default FALSE. timeout (scalar<numeric ]0, Inf[>) request timeout seconds. Default 30. user_agent (scalar<character>) User-Agent header. Default "dereckscompany/connectcore". max_tries (scalar<count [1, Inf[>) retry many times backoff transient failure. 1 (default) disables retry. throttle_rate (scalar<numeric ]0, Inf[> | NULL) client-side rate cap requests per second. NULL (default) disables throttling. ctx (list) extra context forwarded sign (e.g. timestamp source). Default list().

title: connectcore: Reusable Base for REST and WebSocket Data-Source Connectors — connectcore-package

Connector packages extend instead re-implementing transport.

what: Typed transport conditions and the connector recipe — connectcore_conditions
title: Typed transport conditions and the connector recipe — connectcore_conditions
text: connectcore raises classed conditions transport failures, caller branches error type reads structured fields instead regexing message string. Every condition shares connectcore_error root, failure surface adds specific class front . classes additive: message string rlang_error / error / condition parents unchanged, nothing matched message text breaks.

title: Typed transport conditions and the connector recipe — connectcore_conditions
text: response-body field body_snippet (body) rlang::abort() reserves body message formatting; field named body rendered message instead stored. Read e$body_snippet. Every class nests shared roots, ordered specific -> general. API error's full vector c("connectcore_api_error_<status>", "connectcore_api_error", "connectcore_error", "rlang_error", "error", "condition"); response stream errors minus HTTP family layers (connectcore_response_error / connectcore_stream_error, connectcore_error, rlang's classes). per-status class (connectcore_api_error_429, connectcore_api_error_401, ...) lets caller catch one status without catching rest; connectcore_api_error family class catches every HTTP failure; connectcore_error root catches every transport failure kind. abort_api_error() default parse_json_response() envelope, connector keeps default HTTP-status parser inherits free; abort_response_error() covers parsed--malformed body (e.g. fetch_server_time_ms()); abort_stream_error() covers StreamClient transport failure (e.g. $send() closed socket).

title: Typed transport conditions and the connector recipe — connectcore_conditions
text: url stored query-string credentials redacted (see abort_api_error()), logging e$url never leaks secret; e$body_snippet truncated, log-safe slice response body.
code: tryCatch(   client$get_order(id),   connectcore_api_error_429 = function(e) {     Sys.sleep(retry_after(e)) # e$status is 429; read it, don't grep it     retry()   },   connectcore_api_error_401 = function(e) refresh_auth_and_retry(),   connectcore_api_error = function(e) log_failure(status = e$status, url = e$url),   connectcore_error = function(e) bail(e) )

title: Typed transport conditions and the connector recipe — connectcore_conditions
text: connector error envelope (code / msg field signals failure HTTP 200, venue-specific error surface) raises class FRONT connectcore class, venue error still catches shared roots. Define thin raiser connector wire connector's parse_envelope:   caller can catch binance_api_error (venue-specific) connectcore_api_error (HTTP failure across fleet) connectcore_error (transport failure) — whichever granularity wants. connector keeps default HTTP-status envelope, work needed: inherits abort_api_error() parse_json_response() free.
code: # In package `binance`, R/conditions.R abort_binance_error <- function(status, code, msg, url = NULL, body = NULL) {   return(rlang::abort(     message = paste0("Binance error ", code, ": ", msg),     class = c(       sprintf("binance_api_error_%d", as.integer(status)),       "binance_api_error",       # ...then the connectcore family, so `connectcore_api_error` still catches it:       sprintf("connectcore_api_error_%d", as.integer(status)),       "connectcore_api_error",       "connectcore_error"     ),     status = as.integer(status), code = code,     url = connectcore::scrub_url(url),     # Store the body under `body_snippet`, NOT `body`: rlang::abort() reserves     # `body` for message formatting, so a `body =` field is swallowed.     body_snippet = body,     call = rlang::caller_env()   )) }

title: connectcore 0.4.0
text: Typed conditions every transport failure, caller branches error type reads structured fields instead grepping message string. REST call fails, transport base used throw bare message HTTP status buried text; caller wanted retry 429 re-auth 401 regex string, way catch one failure class without catching . connectcore base every connector extends, condition raised inherited fleet-wide — one place fix. abort_api_error(status, url, body, message) — non-2xx HTTP response (default parse_json_response() envelope) signals c("connectcore_api_error_<status>", "connectcore_api_error", "connectcore_error"), carrying status (integer), url, truncated body structured fields. per-status class lets tryCatch(connectcore_api_error_429 = ...) catch one status; family class catches every HTTP failure. abort_response_error(message, field, url, body) — response parsed malformed missing field (e.g. server-time payload lacking key) signals connectcore_response_error. abort_stream_error(message, url) — StreamClient transport failure (e.g. $send() closed socket) signals connectcore_stream_error. Backward compatible — every existing error message byte-identical bare rlang::abort() string replaced, tests downstream greps matched message text keep working; classes fields purely additive. Golden tests pin byte-identity. scrub_url() — URL stored condition (logged) value every credential-named query parameter (signature, apiKey, token, …) redacted <redacted>, e$url never leaks secret preserving path benign parameters debugging. Exported connectors reuse. Structured WebSocket lifecycle events — WebSocket analogue typed conditions, client whose error surface asynchronous events rather catchable throws (refs dereckscompany/aisstream#3). StreamClient used hand raw callback payload string-keyed $(event, ...) handler, callers can now register single $on_event(handler) receives typed object every lifecycle transition, branch event$event_type reading fields data. StreamClient$on_event(handler) — registers handler receives typed ws_event object every lifecycle transition: open, message, close, error, reconnect (see WS_EVENT_TYPES). event carries lubridate UTC timestamp per-type fields — close carries code + reason, reconnect carries attempt + delay (backoff seconds), open carries reconnect (reconnect), message carries data (frame text), error carries error (socket error event). Additive zero-cost unused — existing $() callbacks fire exactly (verified two current consumers, binance::BinanceWsBase aisstream::AisStream, register $on_event() handler unaffected), typed object — including timestamp — materialised least one $on_event() handler registered, parse-free recorder hot path stays free default. ws_event(event_type, fields) WS_EVENT_TYPES exported — constructor WebSocket connector uses emit structured events (e.g. parsed error frame), event_type value set branch instead bare string literals. Durable pkgdown documentation build (closes #5) — docs workflow prone failing renv lockfile durably track development tools site build needs (pkgdown packages vignettes load); future renv::snapshot() old settings silently drop , reintroducing htmltools dyn.load failure class. adopts proven binance recipe: renv settings snapshot.dev: true lockfile.sanitize: true, renv upgraded 1.1.8 -> 1.2.3 (snapshot.dev setting 1.2.x feature, must recorded lock CI’s setup-renv honour ), lockfile regenerated tracks current dev tree. regeneration adds genuinely-needed dev dependencies (roxygen2, brew, commonmark, stringr) sanitises 13 stale, unreachable entries (ggplot2 / DT / widget ecosystem, none connectcore, vignette, pkgdown use). pkgdown workflow now builds install = TRUE. Verified locally pkgdown::build_site() completing (CI proof waits org’s Actions billing).

title: connectcore 0.3.0
text: Centralise fleet-wide ms_to_datetime() measurement-time helper. Connectors parse raw JSON timestamp fields whose R type known ahead time — field numeric populated, character venues, -NA logical batch records came back empty — shared helper must type-stable, length-preserving, NA--> NA-. connectcore already shipped ms_to_datetime(), thin as_datetime(.numeric(ms) / 1000) form: warned -NA character input (documented missing-value path), runtime-typed, -missing batch collapse single NA data.table::set() recycles column’s existing storage type rather replacing POSIXct one. ports kucoin’s hardened implementation — fleet reference — single canonical copy, wrapper drops local re-implementation converges. ms_to_datetime(ms) now accepts raw JSON value untyped (numeric, character, -NA logical), always returns POSIXct/UTC vector whose length matches input, maps NULL/NA NA, stays silent -NA missing-value path, still surfaces usual “NAs introduced coercion” warning genuinely malformed string. argument return runtime-checked roxyassert. Dependency CI reconciliation (fleet convergence, behaviour change): Config/roxygen2/version pinned 7.3.3 alongside RoxygenNote; version floor added assert Imports roxyassert Suggests; roxyassert Remote de-pinned bare repository entry (exact versions live renv.lock per ratified bare-Remotes-plus-Imports-floors policy); withr promoted Suggests Imports (exported mock-harness activators with_mock_api()/local_mock_api() import run time, R CMD check rightly required hard dependency); previously incomplete renv.lock now records assert, data.table, lubridate websocket runtime dependencies missing; R-CMD-check (3-OS matrix) plus test-coverage now run push pull request rather manual dispatch , fleet’s “merge green gate” rule enforceable.

title: connectcore 0.2.1
text: Fix StreamClient open-check silently broke every WebSocket stream. .is_open() compared readyState() 1L identical(), websocket package returns ATTRIBUTED integer (named OPEN = 1L), identical() FALSE even socket open. Every send() aborted .resubscribe() threw inside onOpen "open" event fired, subscription ever sent stream received nothing (0-byte captures). Now compares value (== 1L). Regression test added.

title: connectcore 0.2.0
text: shared HTTP-mock test harness, exported connector packages use tests vignettes. Every connector hand-rolled near-identical mock_router (response builder, route table, dispatch loop, ~180 lines ); extracts one reusable toolkit generalises cover every routing style connectors use. harness mocks httr2’s native global hook — options(httr2_mock = ...) — intercepts synchronous req_perform() asynchronous req_perform_promise(), connector’s sync async paths render fixtures extra wiring (reason native hook vcr). existing behaviour changes — adds new exports. Migrating connectors onto follow-per connector. mock_router(routes, response_builder = mock_response) — factory returning function(req) dispatcher. route’s match either string (substring req$url — URL-pattern style coinbase, alpaca, binance, kucoin) function(req) -> logical predicate can read URL, method, body (body-routing style hyperliquid). optional method pins route verb; fixture may thunk (invoked per request, closure counter expresses stateful pagination) may return fully-built httr2_response (204 -content, error), passed unchanged. unmatched request raises "Unmocked request: <method> <url>". mock_response(body, status = 200, headers = ...) — response builder: returns httr2_response unchanged, uses single character body verbatim (real-captured-JSON path), JSON-encodes anything else (auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", digits = NA, matching live wire). body_routes(url_filter, field_path, cases) + req_body_json(req) — make body-routed APIs ergonomic: req_body_json() parses req$body$data (raw, character, already-deserialised list) body_routes() builds one predicate-route per named case (match URL contains url_filter body field field_path equals case name). Hyperliquid becomes mock_router(c(body_routes("/exchange", c("action", "type"), .exchange_routes), body_routes("/info", "type", .info_routes))). with_mock_api(routes, code) / local_mock_api(routes, .env) — install mock_router(routes) httr2_mock option scope (via withr) restore afterwards; connector’s tests vignettes call instead hand-setting option. load_fixtures(dir, parse = FALSE) — read every *.json directory named list keyed file basename; value raw JSON string (pairs mock_response()’s verbatim path) parsed list (parse = TRUE). connector loads real captured fixtures route table. jsonlite moves Imports (harness JSON-encodes/decodes bodies); withr (already Suggest) backs scoped activators.

title: connectcore 0.1.0
text: Three additive fixes shared request funnel (build_request()), gap surfaced migrating exchange connectors onto connectcore. funnel extracted connector signs query string (body) talks single host, raw-body path, per-call host override, multi-value query encoding never exercised. Migrating venues need surfaced three. Nothing existing changes behaviour — add new capability fix encoding silently regressed. connector adoptions separate follow-PRs. body_format = "raw" — new body encoding sends pre-serialized character (raw) body byte-verbatim via httr2::req_body_raw(): NULL-pruning, pretty-printing, re-encoding. caller owns serialization. Required venues cryptographically sign exact bytes request body — kucoin (signs compact JSON body, pretty-printing corrupt) hyperliquid (signs body needs null fields preserved, req_body_json drops). sign seam runs body set, body-signing .sign() can read exact bytes req$body$data add signature header. raw_content_type argument (default "application/json") sets Content-Type. "json" / "query" / "none" unchanged. Per-request base_url override — RestClient’s private .request() (build_request()) takes optional base_url overrides instance base single call (default NULL = instance base). dual-host venues — coinbase routes Advanced Trade Exchange hosts per request. .request() also accepts per-call body_format (raw_content_type) single signed endpoint can send raw body even client’s default JSON. Multi-value query params (.multi = "explode") — query encoder now passes .multi = "explode" httr2::req_url_query(), vector-valued entry repeats key (ids = c("", "B") → ids=&ids=B), standard REST convention. httr2 defaults .multi = "error", aborts length > 1 value; silently regressed coinbase methods passing list-valued params. Scalar query values unaffected.

title: connectcore 0.0.1
text: Initial release. shared transport base R data-source connectors. owns transport — domain vocabulary, domain dependencies — meant installed extended connector packages rather used . (exported helpers StreamClient work standalone; RestClient extend-, request funnel private.) RestClient — abstract REST base: synchronous asynchronous (via promises), optional retry client-side throttle, one private .request() funnel every endpoint method delegates . Venue specifics plug overriding two private seams — .sign() (authenticate request) .parse_envelope() (response → data, raise error). defaults -auth “JSON body, error non-2xx”, simple public API works unextended. StreamClient — concrete, event-driven WebSocket base ($(event, handler), Node-style) full-jitter auto-reconnect, keepalive, silence watchdog, proactive reconnect. Subclasses override .dispatch() (frame → events) .resubscribe() (replay subscriptions); recorder needs subclass . Helpers — HMAC-query request signing (hmac_query_sign()), JSON → data.table coercion, epoch ↔︎ POSIXct conversion, environment-backed credential loading, WebSocket backoff. Every argument return typed runtime-checked roxyassert.
